data.taskBrief:
TASK BRIEF: Schedule a Webex calendar meeting with an external attendee (Webex Meetings API)

FIT
  Fully. The supplied request creates a scheduled meeting with start/end times and an external attendee supplied through the invitees array. No supplied requests are unrelated.

AUTH
  OAuth 2.0 Bearer token authentication.
  Header: Authorization: Bearer <bearerToken>. Supply a user token with the meeting:schedules_write scope; the collection does not provide the token value.

BASE URL
  https://webexapis.com

STEPS
  1. POST /v1/meetings
     Params (JSON body):
       topic: string — 'My Meeting'
       start: string (RFC3339 timestamp) — '2026-06-01T15:00:00Z'
       end: string (RFC3339 timestamp) — '2026-06-01T16:00:00Z'
       timezone: string — 'UTC'
       invitees: array of objects — [{"email":"invitee@example.com","displayName":"Invitee Name"}]
       invitees[0].email: string — 'invitee@example.com'
       invitees[0].displayName: string — 'Invitee Name'
       Also accepts: meetingType, enabledJoinBeforeHost, password, siteUrl, hostEmail, enabledAutoRecordMeeting — use only when needed.
     Returns: 200 or 201 on success; the response includes id, meetingNumber, title or topic, start, end, timezone, siteUrl and webLink, and may include password and hostEmail. Errors shown include 400 for missing/invalid fields, 401 for an invalid token, and 403 when the required scope is missing.
     Threading: None

GOTCHAS
  - Send the body as application/json and include Accept: application/json.
  - Use RFC3339/ISO 8601 timestamps for both start and end; scheduled meetings require both.
  - Put the attendee inside the invitees JSON array with an email address; displayName is shown by the request schema.
  - The request schema uses topic, while some saved examples and descriptions refer to title; follow the actual request body field, topic.
  - Replace every {{...}} body placeholder with the intended meeting values. The collection resolves baseUrl to https://webexapis.com, but no bearerToken value is supplied.
  - Do not include /v1 in the base URL; it belongs in the request path.
  - A user token with meeting:schedules_write is required; handle 401 and 403 responses accordingly.
